description: This file serves as a client API wrapper for interacting with a task backend service. It provides functions to handle authentication (login, signup, token management), fetch notes with filters, create and update notes, and logout. The file uses fetch API to perform HTTP requests and manages JWT tokens in localStorage. It's configured to work with environment variables for the API base URL.

methods.name: getToken()
methods.description: Retrieves the authentication token from localStorage, returning an empty string if not available or an error occurs.

methods.name: setToken(token)
methods.description: Stores or removes the authentication token in localStorage based on the presence of a token argument.

methods.name: authHeader()
methods.description: Generates an Authorization header object containing a Bearer token if available.

methods.name: logout()
methods.description: Clears the local session token by removing it from localStorage.

methods.name: isAuthenticated()
methods.description: Checks whether a JWT token exists in localStorage, indicating if the user is authenticated.

methods.name: login({ email, password })
methods.description: Performs a POST request to login endpoint with email and password, stores the received JWT token, and returns the response data.

methods.name: signup({ name, email, password })
methods.description: Performs a POST request to signup endpoint with user details, returning the server’s response.

methods.name: fetchNotes({ user_id, tag_ids, status, priority, archived, q, page, pageSize, sortBy, sortDir } = {})
methods.description: Fetches notes with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination parameters, protected by JWT authentication.

methods.name: createNote({ title, content, status, priority, tags } = {})
methods.description: Creates a new note with specified attributes; protected by JWT authentication.

methods.name: updateNote(id, { title, content, status, priority, archived, tags } = {})
methods.description: Updates an existing note by ID with provided data, protected by JWT authentication.

ctags.name: createNote
ctags.pattern: /^export async function createNote({ title, content, status, priority, tags } = {}) {$/

ctags.name: fetchNotes
ctags.pattern: /^export async function fetchNotes({ user_id, tag_ids, status, priority, archived, q, page, pageSi/
ctags.signature: ({ user_id, tag_ids, status, priority, archived, q, page, pageSize, sortBy, sortDir } = {})

ctags.name: signup
ctags.pattern: /^export async function signup({ name, email, password }) {$/

ctags.name: updateNote
ctags.pattern: /^export async function updateNote(id, { title, content, status, priority, archived, tags } = {}) /
ctags.signature: (id, { title, content, status, priority, archived, tags } = {})
